habitat.locality: Santa Cruz Island near Zamboanga Port, Mindanao, Philippines

bucco_pharyngeal_apparatus.mouth: Subterminal and protruding, with telescopic division

stylets.description: Stylets with sheaths ending in piercing tips

plates.description: Plates absent; anus covered by two large lateral plates

cirrus_E.description: Relatively long; base simple, without peduncle or accordion-like structure

general_claw_morphology.attachment: Claws attach directly to the legs
general_claw_morphology.description: The two middle claws on legs I–III are larger and possess apical accessory points. Basal spurs are stout and slightly curved. The inner two claws on leg IV are slightly larger and also possess accessory points.

gonopore.position: Just in front of leg IV
gonopore.description: Relatively large and surrounded by six small membranes

diagnostic_characters: The two middle claws on legs I–III possess apical accessory points.
The inner two claws on leg IV possess accessory points.
Sensory spines or papillae are absent from the legs.

taxonomy_notes.description: The species was compared with Anisonyches mauritianus and other species of Anisonyches, particularly on the basis of claw morphology.
distinguishing_features: Absence of sensory spines or papillae on all leg pairs.
Less protruding head than Anisonyches mauritianus.

specimen.museum: USNM - National Museum of Natural History, Washington, D.C., USA
